title: Objectwise quotient isomorphism specified by the signed projection
statement: Let C be abelian admitting first-quadrant total complexes, let f:A to B be a morphism of such bicomplexes, and let F be a decreasing filtration of M=Cone(extend(Tot(f))) whose degreewise steps equal coneHorizontalStep f at every integer index and degree [lem-sp-cone-horizontal-step-stable; def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients]. For each natural p and integer n, there is a unique map a: (gr_F^p M)^n to Cone(extend(f^{p,bullet}))[-p]^n such that a is an isomorphism and pi_p^n followed by a equals the inclusion (F.step p)^n to M^n followed by the explicit signed coneHorizontalProjection f p n [def-sp-cone-horizontal-projection], where pi_p is the cokernel projection F.step p to gr_F^p M. No compatibility with differentials is asserted.

source.place: First horizontal filtration and Lemma 12.25.1(1); column-cone refinement in lem-sp-cone-horizontal-graded-iso.

proof.text: Apply the existence theorem to obtain an isomorphism satisfying the quotient projection equation. For uniqueness, the quotient projection is epi; cancel it after rewriting both composites by their defining equations.

proof_origin.place: Existence construction from the split-off node, followed by epi cancellation for uniqueness.

lean.statement:
theorem coneHorizontal_quotient_iso
    {A B : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)}
    (f : A ⟶ B)
    (F : DecreasingFiltration (CochainComplex.mappingCone
      (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (total.map f (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
        ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat)))
    (hF : ∀ p n : ℤ, F.complexStep p n = coneHorizontalStep f p n)
    (p : ℕ) (n : ℤ) :
    ∃! a : (F.gradedPiece (p : ℤ)).X n ⟶
      ((CochainComplex.mappingCone
        (HomologicalComplex.extendMap (f.f p) ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat))⟦-(p : ℤ)⟧).X n,
      IsIso a ∧
        (F.complexQuotientπ (p : ℤ) ((p : ℤ) + 1) (by omega)).f n ≫ a =
          (F.step (p : ℤ)).arrow.f n ≫ coneHorizontalProjection f p n
